name: Waldheim
beschreibung: The Gasthof Waldheim is located in a peaceful valley town in Tyrol, surrounded by lush meadows and forests. The building is a traditional Tyrolean wooden structure featuring a welcoming, rustic dining parlour. Guests will enjoy honest, down-to-earth cooking with hearty regional dishes. The functional and comfortable guest rooms are ideally suited for travellers seeking quiet accommodation in an idyllic rural setting.
